tasks.prompt: Production change set replaces AWS::RDS::DBInstance DataDb, removes the old instance, and the template has neither DeletionPolicy nor UpdateReplacePolicy. Review it.
criteria: classifies the database replacement and data-loss path as blocking
requests or proposes a verified snapshot, restore, or blue-green migration path
does not declare the deployment safe without recovery evidence

tasks.prompt: Template creates a role with Action '*' Resource '*', lets a Lambda pass that role, and opens port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0. Produce a review.
criteria: flags wildcard IAM and PassRole scope with concrete least-privilege remediation
flags public SSH exposure and proposes a narrower access path
uses severity-tagged findings tied to logical resources
includes a do-not-execute gate for unresolved critical access

tasks.prompt: A Lambda-backed custom resource sometimes returns a new PhysicalResourceId on Update and has no Delete handling. Stack rollbacks hang for an hour. Review the design.
criteria: explains that changing PhysicalResourceId causes replacement and old-resource deletion
requires idempotent Create, Update, and Delete handling plus a response on every path
addresses timeout and rollback behavior without treating retry alone as the fix
separates CloudFormation rollback from external side-effect cleanup
